successCriteria.description: The addMonths describe block in tests/unit/shared/date.test.ts contains a test case asserting that a 31-day month transition to a 30-day month clamps the day to 30 (result.getTime() equals the Date.UTC instant for the 30th of the target month).
The test suite passes (npx jest) with the addMonths 31-to-30-day clamping coverage present, and the new/retained test does not mutate the input date (input.getTime() unchanged after addMonths).

constraints: Do not change the semantics of addMonths in src/shared/date/accrual.ts — this phase is test-only; the implementation is already correct and must remain untouched.
Follow the existing test conventions in tests/unit/shared/date.test.ts: construct inputs with Date.UTC(...) and assert via result.getTime() compared to Date.UTC(...).

Do not duplicate an already-present assertion verbatim; if the requested 31-to-30 transition is already covered, either retain the existing case or add a distinct adjacent scenario (different month pair or negative offset) rather than a redundant copy.
outOfScope: Refactoring src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts or src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts to import the shared date helpers — deferred to a later phase.
Changing addMonths/startOfUtcDay/periodContaining semantics or the 10,000-iteration safety bound in src/shared/date/accrual.ts.

entityInvariants.invariant: addMonths(date, months) returns a new Date whose UTC day is clamped to the last day of the target month when the source day exceeds it, and never mutates the input date.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: New/retained test assertions must match the existing Date.UTC(...) construction and getTime() comparison convention used throughout the addMonths describe block.
The test must exercise the actual addMonths export re-exported from src/shared/date (index.ts), not a re-implementation, so the assertion validates the production helper.
